login.title: Sign in to file:Heron  -  client v{version}
login.intro: Connect to a file:Heron server. Your credentials live in your OS credential store; only the server URL is saved on disk.
login.code_help: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
login.session_expired: Your session expired - please sign in again.
login.err_code_required: Enter your authentication or recovery code.
login.err_invalid_totp: That code is incorrect. Try again.
login.err_invalid_recovery: Recovery code is invalid or already used. Each code can only be used once.
login.err_open_main_window: Signed in OK but failed to open main window: {detail}
login.warn_token_not_stored: Signed in, but this token could not be saved: Windows credential storage is unavailable, so you will be asked for it again next launch.

settings.title: Settings
settings.api_token_hint: Manage or revoke this token in the web app under Account → Connected API clients.
settings.language_save_failed:
Couldn't save your language preference to the server: {detail}

The app will keep using {locale} until next launch.
settings.diagnostics_help: Crash dumps always on. Restart the app to apply.
settings.diagnostics_restart_hint: Saved. Restart the app for the logging change to take effect.
settings.open_logs_failed: Couldn't open the log folder. It's at: {path}

expiry_dialog.title: Edit expiry
expiry_dialog.intro: Set a new expiry datetime, or check Never.
expiry_dialog.never_help: When checked, the share is never auto-deleted by the cron. End it manually when you're done.
expiry_dialog.err_invalid_time_body: Use 00-23 for hour and 00-59 for minute.
expiry_dialog.err_past_body: Pick a datetime in the future.

limit_dialog.title: Edit download limit
limit_dialog.intro: Cap the total downloads across all authenticated recipients. Public-link downloads have their own separate budget.
limit_dialog.unlimited_help: When checked, no per-share cap applies. The user quota and public-link cap (if any) still do.
limit_dialog.err_invalid_body: Enter a positive integer (or check Unlimited).

share_detail.copy_failed_body: Couldn't reach the clipboard. The URL is shown in the field above - copy it manually with Ctrl+C.
share_detail.end_share_confirm_body:
End this share now and delete all uploaded files? This cannot be undone.

Subject: {subject}
share_detail.discard_confirm_body: Delete the partially-downloaded data for “{name}”? You'll have to start over.
share_detail.save_all_skipped_body: {count} file(s) could not be saved because the server sent a name this system cannot use: {names}

upload.to_company: Goes to the company - everyone on the team can see it. You don't pick recipients.
upload.files_empty: (drop files here or click to browse)
upload.err_no_recipients_body: Add at least one user or group recipient, or attach an inline public link.
upload.err_invalid_time_body: Use 00-23 for hour and 00-59 for minute.
upload.err_invalid_limit_body: Download limit must be a positive integer, or blank for unlimited.
upload.err_invalid_pl_limit_body: Download limit must be a positive integer, or blank for unlimited.
upload.public_link_result_note: Public link created. Copy it below - it's also on the share's detail page.
upload.status_success: Share created and all files uploaded.
upload.status_partial: Some uploads failed - see dialogs above.

add_files.title: Add files
add_files.intro: Add more files to “{subject}”. They'll be scanned and added to the share.
add_files.notify_label: Notify recipients of the new files
add_files.status_all_failed: All uploads failed - remove or retry.
add_files.notify_failed: Files added, but recipients could not be notified.
